task_spec.prompt: Open the workbook input/sales.xlsx. In sheet 'Q1', put the total of column C (rows 2 through 13) into cell C14, then save the file. Do not change any other cell.
core_assertions: primary: cell C14 equals the exact sum of C2:C13
primary: the file was saved (artifact exists)
no destructive side-effects: no other cell value was changed
task_spec.setup: 对系统提供的 input/sales.xlsx 操作。起始素材由系统在 input/ 统一提供,请勿自建或更换文件——所有产品必须在同一份素材上跑,结果才可比。

dirty_data.note: Clean office-suite pilot: a single unambiguous sum into one cell. Dirty-data (merged cells, hidden rows, text-as-number) belongs to a later stress-tier task.

files.input: input/ — sales.xlsx starting workbook (may be faked)
files.expected: expected/end-state.md — C14 holds SUM(C2:C13), all else unchanged
